diagnostic_definitions.fe: cumulative function evaluations after this generation [count]
diagnostic_definitions.N: population size at generation start after linear reduction [count]
diagnostic_definitions.best: min objective in current population [raw_objective units]
diagnostic_definitions.median: median objective in current population [raw_objective units]
diagnostic_definitions.worst: max objective in current population [raw_objective units]
diagnostic_definitions.diversity: mean over dimensions of std(pop[:,d]) / (ub-lb), dimensionless in [0,~1]
diagnostic_definitions.successes: number of trials that replaced their parent this generation [count]
diagnostic_definitions.attempts: number of trials attempted this generation [count]
diagnostic_definitions.success_F: list of F values for successful trials [dimensionless]
diagnostic_definitions.success_CR: list of CR values for successful trials [dimensionless]
diagnostic_definitions.success_df: list of |parent_fit - trial_fit| for successes [raw_objective units]
diagnostic_definitions.M_F_before: memory slot value of M_F[k] before update this generation [dimensionless]
diagnostic_definitions.M_F_after: M_F[k] after update (or unchanged if no success) [dimensionless]
diagnostic_definitions.memory_slot: k index updated this generation, or -1 if no update [index]
diagnostic_definitions.n_success_candidates: same as successes; kept for clarity [count]
diagnostic_definitions.pbest_ok: True if every sampled pbest index was within top max(2,floor(p*N)) set [bool]
diagnostic_definitions.r_index_ok: True if r1!=i, r2!=i, r2!=r1 held for all trials [bool]
diagnostic_definitions.stall_gen: consecutive generations with improvement <= 0 at end of this gen [count]
